speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS/ME)

I understand the confusion regarding your past records; let's focus on your current symptoms. Since your fatigue is unrelieved by rest and accompanied by concentration difficulties, have you experienced any post-exertional malaise where symptoms worsen significantly after physical or mental activity? Also, do you suffer from unrefreshing sleep or sore throat/lymph node tenderness?
